Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}

Once a clan of philosopher-kings, the Brujah are now passionate revolutionaries, rebels, and idealists, drawn from punks, anarchists, and disaffected radicals as readily as from scholars and agitators of past ages. They are quick to anger and quick to violence in defense of their causes, and many young Brujah gravitate toward gangs, activist circles, or anarch movements that challenge entrenched Kindred authority.

Disciplines: Celerity, Potence, Presence

Advantage: Brujah are formidable in melee, gaining bonuses when fighting unarmed or with improvised weapons, born of their innate physical prowess and aggression.

Disadvantage: The clan's famous temper makes the Brujah highly prone to frenzy, requiring greater self-control to avoid losing themselves to fury when provoked.

Organization: Loosely knit and individualistic, Brujah cluster around shared causes and charismatic leaders rather than rigid hierarchy, and many maintain ties to the rebellious @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.f6a3258d39874a5c]{Anarch Movement} even while nominally Camarilla.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{the Camarilla}, of which Brujah is one of the founding clans.
